# sharprs provenance

This copy of `sharprs` was imported into the Rusty Weather repository by
commit `662405d` on 2026-06-09 from Fahrenheit Research's internal Rust weather
codebase. The import did not record an immutable standalone `sharprs` upstream
revision, so this file deliberately does not claim one.

The source identifies itself as a Rust port of SHARPpy's `sharptab`, and some
scientific formulas were transcribed from that project. Those portions remain
subject to SHARPpy's BSD 3-Clause terms. Fahrenheit Research's original Rust
code is also offered under MIT. The complete notices and conditions are in
[`LICENSE`](LICENSE); redistribution must retain them.

Future updates should record the exact source repository and commit before
copying code into this vendored directory.
